idle-after-drops.desc: Leak check: an image (spotlight on), an audio-less TTS toast and a rain came and went; window starts once all are gone.

image-spotlight.desc: One 400x300 image drop (caption, avatar, reactions) on screen, spotlight ON (default).

three-images.desc: Three image drops on screen, spotlight ON (default settings).

cursor-60hz.desc: One image drop (spotlight OFF) + cursor IPC at 60 Hz sweeping the screen away from the drop (hover hit-testing, no capture).

emoji-rain.desc: Emoji rain (38 particles, 3 emojis) starting with the window, no media.

video-playing.desc: Extra: one 320x240 WebM video drop playing, spotlight OFF.

gif-animated.desc: Extra: one animated 240x180 GIF drop, spotlight OFF.
